slots.genericRequirement: Argon plasma probe sized for the working channel.
slots.includedBy: Included by Bronchoscopic tumor ablation requirements v1.0

slots.label: Flexible cryoprobe
slots.genericRequirement: Cryoprobe for cryoablation or cryoadhesion debulking.
slots.includedBy: Included by Bronchoscopic tumor ablation requirements v1.0

slots.label: Cryotherapy console accessories
slots.genericRequirement: Gas supply, hoses, and console accessories for the cryotherapy unit.
slots.includedBy: Included by Bronchoscopic tumor ablation requirements v1.0

slots.label: Surgical laser console
slots.genericRequirement: Laser generator for endobronchial debulking. Nd:YAG 1064 nm at 20-40 W penetrates 5-15 mm and coagulates before debulking; KTP 532 nm cuts a stricture.
slots.notes: Keep FiO2 and FeO2 at or below 40% while the beam is on. Power above 40 W or pulses longer than 1 s are the reported perforation risk factors.
slots.includedBy: Included by Bronchoscopic tumor ablation requirements v1.0

slots.label: Laser delivery fibre
slots.genericRequirement: Fibre made for the console wavelength; contact or non-contact per the intended effect.
slots.includedBy: Included by Bronchoscopic tumor ablation requirements v1.0

slots.label: Laser safety equipment
slots.genericRequirement: Wavelength-matched eyewear for everyone in the nominal hazard zone, signage, wet drapes, and any required filter unit.
slots.notes: Eyewear is not interchangeable between laser systems. Plan a second suction line for the plume.
slots.includedBy: Included by Bronchoscopic tumor ablation requirements v1.0

slots.label: Bronchoscopic microwave ablation catheter
slots.genericRequirement: Named here because microwave is one of the two most actively developed bronchoscopic ablation modalities. Every device in this category is investigational in the United States, so nothing is selectable: see the emerging-devices view.
slots.notes: No product is available for selection. This slot exists so the card can say microwave is a modality under development rather than imply a catheter is stocked.
slots.includedBy: Included by Bronchoscopic tumor ablation requirements v1.0

slots.label: Pulsed electric field system
slots.genericRequirement: Non-thermal ablation generator. US clearance in this category is for surgical ablation of soft tissue, not an airway indication; the bronchial-rheoplasty system is investigational. See the emerging-devices view.
slots.notes: The soft-tissue-cleared system is selectable and is badged unverified; using it in the airway is outside its cleared indication. The bronchial-rheoplasty system is investigational and cannot be selected at all.
slots.includedBy: Included by Bronchoscopic tumor ablation requirements v1.0

slots.label: Suction setup
slots.genericRequirement: Suction tubing and canisters for clearing debris and blood.
slots.includedBy: Included by Bronchoscopic tumor ablation requirements v1.0

slots.label: Chest tube available for rescue
slots.genericRequirement: Seldinger or pigtail catheter available for pneumothorax after peripheral ablation.
slots.includedBy: Included by Bronchoscopic tumor ablation requirements v1.0

slots.label: Rigid barrel on standby
slots.genericRequirement: Rigid bronchoscope available for airway control if bleeding or obstruction follows debulking.
slots.includedBy: Included by Bronchoscopic tumor ablation requirements v1.0

slots.label: Laser-resistant endotracheal tube
slots.genericRequirement: Laser-resistant tube matched to the wavelength, cuff filled with saline or water.
slots.dependencyRule: Laser planned with an indwelling tube or tracheostomy
slots.notes: A standard endotracheal tube is not recommended when a laser is fired in the airway.
slots.includedBy: Included by Bronchoscopic tumor ablation requirements v1.0

slots.label: Airway stent sizing device
slots.genericRequirement: Optional sizing device for airway stent selection.
slots.includedBy: Included by Rigid bronchoscopy requirements v1.0

slots.label: Surgical laser console
slots.genericRequirement: Laser generator matched to the intended tissue effect. Nd:YAG 1064 nm at 20-40 W is the airway workhorse for deep coagulation before debulking; KTP 532 nm at 15-35 W cuts a web-like stricture before dilation; CO2 for laryngeal and subglottic work.
slots.notes: Mehta’s rule of 4, for a flexible-bronchoscopy laser case: lesion no longer than 4 cm, lung collapsed under 4 weeks, life expectancy over 4 weeks, procedure under 4 hours, FiO2 under 40%, under 40 pulses between fibre cleanings, no more than 4 repeat treatments, a team of 4, and initial settings of 40 W non-contact or 4 W contact at 0.4 s. Sustained power above 40 W or pulses longer than 1 s are the reported risk factors for perforation.
slots.includedBy: Included by Rigid bronchoscopy requirements v1.0

slots.label: Laser delivery fibre
slots.genericRequirement: Fibre made for the console wavelength. Contact with a bare fibre to cut; non-contact with an air-cooled catheter to coagulate and to keep the tip clean.
slots.notes: Distances that matter: the fibre protrudes at least 4 mm beyond the working channel, sits about 4 mm from the lesion, and the tube stays more than 4 cm back from it. Keep coolant airflow low and avoid direct probe-to-tissue contact — air embolism has been attributed to high coolant flow.
slots.includedBy: Included by Rigid bronchoscopy requirements v1.0

slots.label: Laser safety equipment
slots.genericRequirement: Wavelength-matched eyewear for everyone in the nominal hazard zone, door and window signage, wet drapes, sterile water or saline within reach, and any filter unit the console requires.
slots.notes: Eyewear is not interchangeable between laser systems. Plan a second suction line: one for the bronchoscope and one for the mouth, to clear blood, secretions, and the laser plume. Human papillomavirus transmission through surgical plume has been documented, so in recurrent respiratory papillomatosis optimize suction, minimize laser use, and consider cryotherapy instead.
slots.includedBy: Included by Rigid bronchoscopy requirements v1.0

slots.label: Laser-resistant endotracheal tube
slots.genericRequirement: Laser-resistant tube matched to the wavelength in use, with the cuff filled with saline or water rather than air.
slots.dependencyRule: Laser planned with an indwelling tube or tracheostomy
slots.notes: A standard endotracheal tube is not recommended when a laser is fired in the airway. FiO2 and FeO2 both stay at or below 40% while the beam is on.
slots.includedBy: Included by Rigid bronchoscopy requirements v1.0

slots.label: Fluoroscopy C-arm

slots.includedBy: Included by Rigid bronchoscopy requirements v1.0

slots.notes: Normally recorded as a custom line describing what the room stocks.
slots.includedBy: Included by Rigid bronchoscopy requirements v1.0
